• **"Fundamental"** refers to something that is basic and **essential;** forming the f**oundation or core**. (मूलभूत)

 
 
• **Example: **Understanding basic mathematics is **fundamental **to learning advanced science.
 
 
 
• Here in this sentence from the passage asks for a vocabulary that means **'something very basic or grounded'. **So, **'fundamental**' is the appropriate word to justify the meaning of the 1st sentece of the abovementioned paragraph.
 
• we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank (number 1) is **'fundamental'**.

Hence, the correct statement is '***Education should be free to all because it is a fundamental__ human right'***

• **Lovely** (सुंदर): Very beautiful or attractive.

• **Precious** (कीमती): Of great value; not to be wasted or treated carelessly.
 
 
• **Example: **Time is** precious**, so use it wisely.
 
 
 
• **Joyful** (आनंदमय): Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness.
